description: Counter, totalizer, speedometer, timer and cyclic timer controllers over Modbus RTU: process values, set points, output times, flags and the full configuration of each mode
source: Contemp, Mapa de Registros Modbus KT504, KT506, KT507, revision 06, software V1.12 or later
notes: Modbus RTU slave on RS-485: address 1 to 247 (register 232), 9600 to 57600 bit/s (register 233), parity none, odd or even (register 234), 8 data bits, 1 or 2 stop bits. Function 17 (report slave ID) returns the product name, software version and options.
Register numbers are those of the manual, counted from 1 ('one based').
Values of two registers (HI and LO) are 32-bit signed numbers: HI x 65536 + LO, high register first (the manual's note 1).

Registers 1 to 81 are the operation block: process value and set points of the active mode, then common status. Registers 100 and up are the configuration block, listed by mode; use the registers of the mode selected in register 100 (tYPE).
Written from the manufacturer's register map; not tested on a device.
